title: Research: no two-target UT4 central word has n_b=6 (n_b=7 open; no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Answers the `n_b = 6` half of open next question 2 in [#1816](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1816). In the explicit `F_2[UT_4(F_2)]` central-target alphabet of [#1662](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1662), no legal word realizing two central targets — of any finite length, on any finite restored dirty workspace — has exactly six paid `b` calls. Combined with #1662’s `n_b ≥ 6`, every such word has `n_b ≥ 7`. The case `n_b = 7` is left open.

At `n_b = 6` the middle quotient forces `rank X = rank Y = 2`, so every `b` coupling lies in the active 2-plane. Interior dirty contractions then cannot touch the `{a,b}` / `{c,b}` side coefficients or the cross coefficients `abc` and `cba`. Those necessary equations reduce to a two-role profile problem with unrestricted outer length.

The census enumerates all 5,582 GL2-minimal zero-sum length-6 middle sequences, keeps the 5,400 with both middle ranks at least two, builds every side-zero transport key, and pairs keys for `abc = cba = I_2`. **Zero pairs survive.** All 138,240 identity key pairs that do appear sit on the 182 low-rank middles, so the screen is not empty by accident.

**Scope.** Quotient-level obstruction for `n_b = 6` only. Does not restate the unit-tariff minimum 16 from #1816, does not reopen three-target lengths 21/22, and does not claim a word with `n_b = 7`. No supplier or κ change.

**No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/ut4-two-target-no-six-b/`
- Tip: `1db88eeb57f21689a8a8f025c2535f50b816414d`
- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`
- Scope: **refined** — decide `n_b = 6` only

Closest prior: [#1662](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1662) (`n_b ≥ 6`) and [#1816](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1816) (unit-tariff exact 16; weighted OQ2). The #1690 profile/key pipeline is reused for the census, but the rank-(2,2) filter and the unbounded dirty reduction newly close `n_b = 6` rather than retargeting the unit-tariff result.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/ut4-two-target-no-six-b/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/ut4-two-target-no-six-b/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/ut4-two-target-no-six-b/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/ut4-two-target-no-six-b/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/ut4-two-target-no-six-b
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_UT4_TWO_TARGET_NO_NB6 key_pairs=0 middles=5400
PASS_UT4_TWO_TARGET_NO_NB6_INDEPENDENT key_pairs=0 keys_sum=1568064
PASS_UT4_TWO_TARGET_NO_NB6_PACKAGE_CONTROLS checks=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/ut4-two-target-no-six-b outcome=negative-result
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`. A temporary copy of `CERTIFICATE.json` with corrupted pairs is rejected, and duplicate JSON keys are rejected. `independent.py` does not import `verify.py`.

## Open next questions

1. Does any two-target word have `n_b = 7` at any length and any finite dirty workspace? Extend the unrestricted-profile key census to length-7 middles on rank patterns `(2,2)`, `(2,3)`, `(3,2)`, or find an algebraic obstruction. Blocked by `16^7` profiles and middle excess when a middle rank is 3.
